answer: Quorum signatures are checked on-chain, and operators are slashed for signing unavailable data. A farm needs 362 quorum signatures, since one quorum cannot attest 362 different dispersals. EigenDA disperses data to operators, and a quorum signature proves the data is available. Watch the raven: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the mirror bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the karst audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
